description: This file defines the 'SerialPort' class, which is part of the jSSC (Java Simple Serial Connector) library. The class provides methods for serial port communication, including opening/closing ports, configuring port parameters, reading/writing data, handling events and port lines, and managing flow control. It interacts with the native interface for platform-specific serial port operations.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: Main class for managing serial port communication, including configuration, data transfer, event handling, and port line control.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Internal class representing a thread that processes serial port events for Windows and other OS types.

classes.name: LinuxEventThread
classes.description: Internal subclass of EventThread tailored for Linux, Solaris, and macOS OS to handle serial port events and line status changes.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port.

methods.name: isOpened
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is currently open.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens the serial port with proper error handling for various failure modes.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Configures port parameters like baud rate, data bits, stop bits, and parity.

methods.name: setParams (overload with RTS and DTR flags)
methods.description: Configures port parameters including initial RTS and DTR states.

methods.name: purgePort
methods.description: Purges input/output buffer based on specified flags.

methods.name: setEventsMask
methods.description: Sets the event mask to specify which events should trigger.

methods.name: getEventsMask
methods.description: Retrieves the current event mask.

methods.name: setRTS
methods.description: Sets the RTS line high or low.

methods.name: setDTR
methods.description: Sets the DTR line high or low.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Sends an array of bytes to the serial port.

methods.name: writeByte
methods.description: Sends a single byte to the serial port.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Sends a string to the serial port.

methods.name: writeString (with charsetName)
methods.description: Sends a string with specified charset encoding.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Sends a single integer value (byte) to the serial port.

methods.name: writeIntArray
methods.description: Sends an array of integers (bytes) to the serial port.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the serial port.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes and converts to String.

methods.name: readHexString
methods.description: Reads bytes and converts to a hex string with default separator.

methods.name: readHexString (with separator)
methods.description: Reads bytes and converts to a hex string with specified separator.

methods.name: readHexStringArray
methods.description: Returns an array of hex string representations of the read bytes.

methods.name: readIntArray
methods.description: Returns an array of integers representing the read bytes.

methods.name: waitBytesWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits until the specified number of bytes are available or timeout occurs.

methods.name: readBytes (with timeout)
methods.description: Reads bytes with a specified timeout using waitBytesWithTimeout.

methods.name: readString (with timeout)
methods.description: Reads string with timeout.

methods.name: readHexString (with timeout)
methods.description: Reads hex string with timeout.

methods.name: readHexString (with separator and timeout)
methods.description: Reads hex string with custom separator and timeout.

methods.name: readHexStringArray (with timeout)
methods.description: Reads bytes and returns array of hex string representations with timeout.

methods.name: readIntArray (with timeout)
methods.description: Reads bytes and returns array of integers with timeout.

methods.name: getInputBufferBytesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently in input buffer.

methods.name: getOutputBufferBytesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently in output buffer.

methods.name: setFlowControlMode
methods.description: Sets flow control mode using predefined constants.

methods.name: getFlowControlMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current flow control mode.

methods.name: sendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal for specified duration.

methods.name: getLinesStatus
methods.description: Returns status of the control lines (CTS, DSR, RING, RLSD).

methods.name: isCTS
methods.description: Checks whether CTS line is active.

methods.name: isDSR
methods.description: Checks whether DSR line is active.

methods.name: isRING
methods.description: Checks whether RING line is active.

methods.name: isRLSD
methods.description: Checks whether RLSD (DCD) line is active.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds a serial port event listener with default or specified mask.

methods.name: removeEventListener
methods.description: Removes the event listener and terminates event thread.

methods.name: closePort
methods.description: Closes the serial port and removes event listener.
